channel.title: Covering Katy News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Covering Katy News (coveringkaty.com)

item.title: Mold Insurance Claims: A Katy doctor reveals why homeowners face insurance denials and what to know when you are fighting back
item.description: Dr. Matt Everett explains why homeowners insurance often denies mold claims and what families can do when water damage leads to health problems and claim rejections.

item.title: Union Pacific Developing 2,040-Acre Industrial Park Near Rosenberg, Could Bring Thousands of Jobs
item.description: Union Pacific Railroad is developing a 2,040-acre industrial park in Rosenberg's extraterritorial jurisdiction that could bring thousands of jobs and significant economic growth to the area, located about 38 miles southwest of downtown Houston.

item.title: Fulshear Approves $50,000 Small Business Grant Program With Up to $10K Per Business
item.description: The program, developed by the Fulshear Development Corporation, offers up to 50% reimbursement for project costs, not exceeding $10,000. The initial budget for the program is $50,000.

item.title: Suspect arrested in Katy armored car robbery was free on probation after shooting a man
item.description: A Houston man accused of robbing a Brinks armored car in Katy had been set free on probation just one month earlier after being convicted of shooting a man in Houston, according to court records obtained by Covering Katy News.

item.title: New walkable shopping and dining center coming to Katy Area in 2027
item.description: The Oaks of District West will be located at 21711 FM-1093 in Richmond, just east of Peek Road on the eastbound side. The development will feature approximately 87,244 square feet of retail, restaurant and entertainment space across 10 buildings.

item.title: Woman Paralyzed After Fleeing DWI Suspect Crashes on Fry Road in Katy area
item.description: A Cypress man is charged with intoxication assault and evading arrest after a short police pursuit ended in a Dec. 17 crash in the Katy area that left an innocent driver paralyzed.

item.title: Lawyers for a Katy man charged with murdering his mother trying to spring him from jail pending trial
item.description: Attorneys for a Katy man charged with killing his mother are challenging his detention in the Harris County Jail, where he has been held since June on charges he fatally beat Lisa Babin with a hammer at their Katy-area home.

item.title: Court Document Details: Harris County Treasurer Carla Wyatt Charged With Burglary of Motor Vehicle
item.description: Court documents obtained by Covering Katy News provides details of the Dec. 27 arrest of Harris County Treasurer Carla Wyatt, who has been charged with burglary of a motor vehicle after being found inside someone else's.

item.title: How Personal Loans Can Help Consolidate Debt and Improve Your Financial Situation in 2026
item.description: The average American household carries $104,755 in debt, including mortgages, credit cards, auto loans and student loans, offer a practical consolidation solution.

item.title: 5 Steps for Revitalizing Downtown Katy and Why Taxing Churches Isn't One of Them
item.description: Downtown Katy doesn't need taxes on churches—it needs a real revitalization strategy. This commentary by Covering Katy's publisher provides five steps forward.
